note: TV providers and streaming services. 'localsMatchOta' means the provider carries local stations on the same channel number as their over-the-air virtual channel (true for DirecTV and Dish in nearly every market). 'national' gives channel numbers for national sports channels on that provider. Streaming services have no channel numbers; 'guideHint' tells the user how to find the station. 'carries' lists which network feeds a service delivers, used for the access check.
